description: End-task A/B: agent with brainkm MCP vs without, on MemNetwork repo tasks

seed_neurons.title: Hard 1500-token pack budget
seed_neurons.content: Agent-facing context packs (pack_text + compact MCP JSON) are hard-capped at 1500 tokens so injected memory stays a hint, not a dump. Config field: budget.total_tokens default 1500. Always verify packs in source before editing.

seed_neurons.title: remember is pin/correct only
seed_neurons.content: MCP remember is for pin (durable truth), correct (supersede wrong auto-capture), or archive. Ordinary session learning comes from hooks (SessionEnd distill, PostToolUse observe), not remember.

seed_neurons.title: Architecture layers MCP to SQLite
seed_neurons.content: Strict layering: MCP tool → service → adapter → SQLite. Never skip layers. Handlers stay thin; WriteQueue owns writes.

seed_neurons.title: PreCompact handover before host compaction
seed_neurons.content: Cursor chat compaction is lossy. PreCompact hook runs brainkm handover so architectural truth lands in brain.db before the host summarizes the window.

seed_neurons.title: LongMemEval uses fts_primary fusion
seed_neurons.content: LongMemEval hybrid bench forces SemanticConfig fusion_mode=fts_primary so MiniLM only re-ranks FTS candidates. Equal RRF previously collapsed R@5 to ~0.37 on long session haystacks by promoting non-lexical vector noise.

seed_neurons.title: Dual-grain LongMemEval indexing
seed_neurons.content: Default LongMemEval index is dual-grain: whole-session blobs for FTS (fts-blob) plus optional chunk embeddings for --semantic. Legacy all-chunk mode is --chunked. Restored full-500 FTS R@5 to 0.934.

seed_neurons.title: recall@budget is the headline metric
seed_neurons.content: Public headline metric is recall@budget: gold fact present in the <=1500-token pack truncation.included_ids, plus pack noise rate. LongMemEval recall_any@K remains a shared-protocol footnote vs agentmemory.

seed_neurons.title: CMA micro-avg is a regression gate
seed_neurons.content: CMA ability micro-average saturated at 100% on v3. Quote recall@budget and hard-slice lift publicly; treat CMA micro as a regression gate, not a leaderboard claim.

seed_neurons.title: Never store secrets in neurons
seed_neurons.content: Security rule: never store API keys, tokens, or passwords in neurons. Use adapters/redaction.py. Off-domain theme-leak queries must abstain.

seed_neurons.title: get_settings vs BrainConfig
seed_neurons.content: Use get_settings() for env; BrainConfig for .brain/config.json. No os.environ in app code under brainkm/brainkm/.

seed_neurons.title: Multi-client coexistence
seed_neurons.content: One brain shared across Cursor, Claude Code, and Antigravity via brainkm serve (HTTP) + connect. Antigravity MCP field is serverUrl (not url). Cursor Memories are cross-project prefs; brainkm is this project's decisions.

seed_neurons.title: traverse for blast radius
seed_neurons.content: For call/import/flow and blast-radius questions prefer MCP traverse with a symbol or path, then verify in source. Empty traverse usually means stale graph — run graph sync.

seed_neurons.title: Graphify auto-sync after edits
seed_neurons.content: MCP server debounces graph sync after Write/Edit. Disable via .brain/config.json graphify.auto_sync.enabled=false.

seed_neurons.title: Hybrid collapse on whole-session blobs
seed_neurons.content: Embedding entire 4k-char sessions into a 128-token MiniLM encoder collapsed LongMemEval hybrid R@5 to ~0.37. Fix: chunk sessions before embed; use fts_primary or dual-grain blob FTS.

seed_neurons.title: How to run CMA scorecard
seed_neurons.content: Run: bash brainkm/scripts/run_cma.sh or brainkm bench run cma --write-scorecard docs/benchmarks/YYYY-MM-DD-cma.md. Primary coding-agent diagnostic.

seed_neurons.title: Preferred setup path
seed_neurons.content: Prefer brainkm configure (TUI) over memorizing serve/connect. Dev: bash brainkm/scripts/setup_dev.sh && pip install -e ./brainkm[tui].

seed_neurons.title: V1 store is SQLite FTS5 + graph
seed_neurons.content: Per-project brain lives at .brain/brain.db — SQLite FTS5 for memory search plus a code graph imported from Graphify.

seed_neurons.title: MCP tool surface
seed_neurons.content: MCP tools: remember, recall, context_pack, traverse, brain_stats, forget, graph_sync, session_status (some absorbed/CLI-only depending on version). Keep agent-facing JSON compact under the token cap.

seed_neurons.title: IR metrics module
seed_neurons.content: brainkm.services.ir_metrics provides recall_at_k, precision_at_k, mrr, ndcg_at_k, recall_at_budget, pack_noise_rate for benches.

seed_neurons.title: Single-writer WriteQueue
seed_neurons.content: All DB-touching MCP handlers run through the single-writer WriteQueue (_run_write in dispatch.py). Never open ad-hoc write connections from handlers.

seed_neurons.title: Python 3.11 or 3.12 recommended
seed_neurons.content: Develop on Python 3.11 or 3.12. Avoid 3.14+ for now — some deps may lack wheels.

seed_neurons.title: hygiene over injecting junk
seed_neurons.content: Prefer brainkm hygiene (or injection noise gate) over injecting junk neurons. Packs are hints — always verify in source.

seed_neurons.title: dispatch_tool router
seed_neurons.content: tools/dispatch.py owns handle_* MCP handlers and dispatch_tool router. All writes go through WriteQueue.

seed_neurons.title: compile_context_pack
seed_neurons.content: services/context_pack.py compile_context_pack builds TruncationManifest with included_ids under adaptive_token_budget.

seed_neurons.title: bench_runner suite registry
seed_neurons.content: services/bench_runner.py maps suite names (cma, longmemeval, staleness, scale, cost, …) to run_*_suite callables.

seed_neurons.title: BrainConfig Pydantic schema
seed_neurons.content: models/brain_config.py defines BrainConfig including BudgetConfig.total_tokens and SemanticConfig.fusion_mode.

seed_neurons.title: Typer CLI entry
seed_neurons.content: cli.py is the Typer app: configure, install, connect, bench run, mcp, serve, graph sync, hygiene, handover.

seed_neurons.title: hybrid_seed fusion
seed_neurons.content: services/search.py hybrid_seed fuses FTS with vectors via RRF or fts_primary depending on SemanticConfig.fusion_mode.

seed_neurons.title: ir_metrics functions
seed_neurons.content: services/ir_metrics.py — recall_at_budget and pack_noise_rate score gold-in-pack under the token cap.

seed_neurons.title: longmemeval_bench dual-grain
seed_neurons.content: services/longmemeval_bench.py indexes haystacks as fts-blob by default; --chunked for legacy; --semantic for hybrid-dual-grain.

tasks.prompt: State the mandatory brainkm architecture layering from MCP tool down to storage.

tasks.reference: fts-blob default; chunks for semantic; --chunked legacy.

tasks.prompt: What is the security rule about storing secrets in the brain?
Which three agent hosts share one brainkm brain, and what is the Antigravity HTTP MCP field name?

In brainkm/brainkm/services/ir_metrics.py, ensure both `recall_at_budget` and `pack_noise_rate` are defined and documented. If missing, add them. Do not change unrelated files. Keep the 1500-token pack contract in mind.

grade.command: rg -n '^def recall_at_budget' brainkm/brainkm/services/ir_metrics.py && rg -n '^def pack_noise_rate' brainkm/brainkm/services/ir_metrics.py

tasks.prompt: Confirm that the staleness suite is registered in brainkm/brainkm/services/bench_runner.py. If missing, register it following the existing pattern for other suites. Minimal change only.
Confirm SemanticConfig.fusion_mode exists in brainkm/brainkm/models/brain_config.py with values including fts_primary. Add it only if missing, matching project style.
Confirm BudgetConfig / total_tokens defaults to 1500 in brainkm/brainkm/models/brain_config.py. Fix only if wrong.
Ensure the end-task fixture file exists at brainkm/brainkm/bench/fixtures/endtask_v1.json with an id field endtask_v1. Create a minimal stub only if missing.
Confirm run_longmemeval_suite accepts a chunked parameter in longmemeval_bench.py. Add it only if missing, default False.
Confirm the CLI bench run command exposes --chunked for LongMemEval. Add only if missing.
Confirm docs/benchmarks/COMPARISON.md mentions recall@budget. If the file exists but lacks the phrase, add a short sentence. Do not invent false numbers.
